description_en: Queries the error code redirection configurations
description_zh: 查询错误码重定向配置列表
name: ListErrorPagesRedirectRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

global: Global configurations.
rule: Rule configurations
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置；
rule：查询规则配置；
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页几条，最大500，不传时默认500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

Rule.description_en:
The rule content. Uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
